Project exact §8 current result with current-role redaction while preserving original immutable receipt/request/actor separately. READ_RESULT is adapter-generated for GET, never an additional browser Accept field. Legacy V1 decoding is restricted to genuine saved pre-existing legacy operation/request recovery under its exact retained contract; never construct a legacy envelope for a fresh V3 operation or rewrite a saved receipt into a new acceptance. GET allocates no request/mutation journal, command, review or job and never changes accepted terms. Existing qualified financial-history/reconcile actions and Source pay-decision pending semantics remain separate; no fresh completed-Move repair wizard, second confirmation or generic Continue physical staging. Preparation retry is an exact native job action, not a second Move accept.
